subject: dartRverse 1.3.0 is on CRAN – please update (and retire dartR 2.9.9.5)

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: dartRverse 1.3.0 is on CRAN – please update (and retire dartR 2.9.9.5)
parts:
Dear dartRverse users,

We are happy to announce that dartRverse 1.3.0 and all of its packages are now on CRAN.

Most of the new functions in this release are about installing the packages and about working with large datasets through file-backed (FBM) storage. Beyond that, we have checked all other functions, now more than 200 across the dartRverse, for errors and for consistency in their arguments, messages and output. Many small bugs were fixed along the way, so even if you don't need the new features, it is worth updating.

WHAT IS NEW

- File-backed (FBM) genotype storage. Large datasets can now be analysed with the genotypes held in a file on disk instead of in memory. Functions read the data in blocks of loci and give the same results as for data held in memory, so your code does not need to change. Read data straight into this form with gl.read.dart(..., fbm = TRUE), or convert an existing object with gl.gen2fbm().
- Easier installation and updates. dartRverse_install() has been rewritten. It installs the Bioconductor dependencies for you, installs everything with dartRverse_install("all"), updates packages without restarting R, and reports clearly when something fails.
- External programs. gl.download.binary() now shows a clickable table of the programs some dartR functions use (PLINK, STRUCTURE, NeEstimator, COLONY, ...). It also has a new program for gl.relatedness().
- dartR.captive has new functions for relatedness, parentage, inbreeding and error rates.

HOW TO INSTALL

install.packages("dartRverse", repos = "https://cran.r-project.org", type = "source")
library(dartRverse)
dartRverse_install("all")

On Windows and macOS, CRAN may still offer the old binary (dartRverse 1.0.6) for a while, which is why the command above installs from source. dartRverse has no compiled code, so no extra tools are needed. Run dartRverse_install() without arguments to see which versions you have and which are available.

check if dartRverse_install() is showing only packages >=1.3.0

ONE IMPORTANT RULE FOR FILE-BACKED OBJECTS

Always save and load with gl.save() and gl.load(), never with saveRDS() or save(). A file-backed object only holds a reference to a temporary file, so saveRDS() writes a file without the genotypes.

PLEASE STOP USING dartR 2.9.9.5

The old single package dartR (version 2.9.9.5) is the legacy version. It is no longer developed or fixed, and its results can differ from the current, checked functions. Please do not use it any more. Uninstall it with remove.packages("dartR") and use the dartRverse packages instead. All of its functionality lives on in dartR.base and the add-on packages.

The attached overview (dartRverse_1.3.0_overview.pdf) explains installation, FBM objects and the external programs step by step.

As always, questions, problems and suggestions are welcome here in the group.

Best wishes,

Bernd, Luis, Arthur, ChingChing, Diana, Emily, Carlo and Peter
the dartRverse team

More details can be found in tdartRverse overview 1.3.0 pdf
